Class TextureHelper

java.lang.Object
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.texture.TextureHelper
public class TextureHelper extends Object
Helper functions for custom texture factories. See TextureProviderBase for the difference between image and texture ids and for information on scaling.

    • copyImage

      public static void copyImage(BufferedImage image, Textures textures, net.minecraft.resources.Identifier src, int x, int y, int width, int height, int u, int v)
      Copies an image to another image.
      Parameters:
      image - The target image.
      textures - A Textures object to resolve the source image and scales.
      src - The source image location.
      x - Unscaled x position on target image.
      y - Unscaled y position on target image.
      width - Unscaled width of area to copy.
      height - Unscaled height of area to copy.
      u - Unscaled x position on source image.
      v - Unscaled y position on source image.

    • clear

      public static void clear(BufferedImage image, Textures textures, int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Clears an area on an image. All pixels will be set transparent.
      Parameters:
      image - The image to clear.
      textures - A Textures object to resolve scales.
      x - Unscaled x position.
      y - Unscaled y position.
      width - Unscaled width of area to clear.
      height - Unscaled height of area to clear.
